info.name: Rapid Capsule API Collection v4.0
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Rapid Capsule Telemedicine Platform.

**Patient API**: https://api.rapidcapsule.com/api
**Specialist API**: https://api.rapidcapsule.com/api
**Admin API**: https://admin.rapidcapsule.com/admin-api

Total Endpoints: 800+

Includes: Biometric/WebAuthn Authentication, Session Management, Notifications, RxGPT AI Prescription Analysis, Linked Records, Admin RxGPT Management

Created by Bassey Eyo (eyobassey@gmail.com) - Founder & CTO

item.name: Patient API
item.description: Endpoints for patient users - authentication, profile, appointments, health checkups, prescriptions, pharmacy, vitals, and wallet management.

item.name: RxGPT (AI Prescription Analysis)
item.description: AI-powered prescription safety analysis - drug interactions, allergy checking, dosage validation, medication suggestions, and analysis history. Credit-based usage system.
